models.name: todo_app_guests
models.description:
Temporary guest accounts for anonymous browsing identified by device fingerprint.

Guest actors represent unauthenticated users who can access the system without email/password registration. Each guest is uniquely identified by their device fingerprint, enabling session persistence across requests from the same device.

Key characteristics:
- No email/password authentication (use todo_app_members for registered users)
- Device fingerprint serves as unique identifier
- Supports temporary session management via todo_app_guest_sessions
- Soft delete support for guest account cleanup

plainFields.name: device_fingerprint
plainFields.description: Unique device fingerprint identifying the guest device. Used for guest identification and session association.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the guest account was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the guest account was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the guest account was soft deleted. Null if the account is active.

models.name: todo_app_guest_sessions
models.description:
Temporary session tokens for guest access with short expiration. Tracks connection metadata for unauthenticated guest users including IP address, URL, and referrer information for session auditing and security purposes.

This session table belongs to the {@link todo_app_guests} actor table and stores append-only login session records. Each guest can have multiple concurrent sessions, and sessions are automatically expired based on the expired_at timestamp for security.

Key characteristics:
- Append-only audit trail of guest login events
- Managed through authentication flows, not direct user CRUD
- Short expiration period for temporary guest access
- Connection context for security monitoring

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: Client IP address for session tracking and security auditing.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Client URL for session tracking and context.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Client referrer URL for session tracking and context.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Session creation timestamp for audit trail.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Session expiration timestamp for security enforcement.

models.name: todo_app_members
models.description:
Registered member accounts with email/password authentication credentials and profile data.

This table represents the canonical identity records for authenticated members in the system. Each member owns their private todo items and has one-to-many sessions stored in the {@link todo_app_member_sessions} table.

Key relationships:
- Owns {@link todo_app_todos} via userId foreign key
- Has {@link todo_app_member_sessions} for authentication
- Has {@link todo_app_member_password_resets} for password recovery
- Has {@link todo_app_member_email_verifications} for registration confirmation

Account deletion triggers cascade deletion of all owned todos and their histories.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: User's email address for authentication. Must be unique across all members.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Hashed password for secure authentication. Never stored in plain text.

plainFields.name: display_name
plainFields.description: User's display name (1-100 characters). Visible in the user's profile.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Account creation timestamp. Immutable after registration.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp. Updated on profile changes.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp for account deletion. When set, account is considered deleted and all owned data is permanently removed.

models.name: todo_app_member_sessions
models.description:
JWT session tokens for member authentication with connection metadata and temporal tracking. Each session record captures a single login event for a {@link todo_app_members} member, storing IP address, request context, and expiration information for security auditing and session management.

Sessions are append-only audit trail entries that track when members authenticate to the system. Each member can have multiple active sessions simultaneously, enabling multi-device access while maintaining security through expiration policies.

Related to {@link todo_app_members} through a 1:N relationship where one member owns many sessions.

foreignFields.name: todo_app_member_id
foreignFields.description: Member who owns this session. {@link todo_app_members.id}.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address of the client that created this session.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: URL of the login endpoint or page where authentication occurred.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer header from the client request during login.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this session was created (login time).

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this session expires and becomes invalid for authentication.

models.name: todo_app_member_password_resets
models.description:
Password reset tokens with expiration for account recovery workflow.

Stores one-time use tokens generated when members request password resets. Each token is associated with a specific member and has an expiration time after which it becomes invalid. Tokens are consumed upon successful password reset and cannot be reused.

This table supports the password change workflow by providing secure, time-limited tokens that verify the member's identity before allowing password modification. Tokens are automatically cleaned up after expiration or consumption.

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Unique password reset token. Generated cryptographically secure random string for one-time use.

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: Token expiration timestamp. Token becomes invalid after this time and cannot be used for password reset.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp. When the password reset token was generated.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record last update timestamp. Updated when token is consumed or modified.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp. Set when token is consumed or manually invalidated.

models.name: todo_app_member_email_verifications
models.description:
Email verification tokens for new member registration confirmation. Each verification record stores a unique token sent to the member's email address, with expiration timestamp for security. Used in the registration workflow to confirm email ownership before activating the account.

This table supports the member registration process by:
- Storing verification tokens with expiration
- Linking to the pending member account via {@link todo_app_members.id}
- Enabling token validation during email confirmation
- Supporting token renewal through new verification records

foreignFields.name: todo_app_member_id
foreignFields.description: Member account awaiting email verification. {@link todo_app_members.id}

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Cryptographically secure verification token sent to the member's email address.

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: Token expiration timestamp. Tokens are invalid after this time.

plainFields.name: verified_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the email was successfully verified. Null if not yet verified.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp for cleanup.

models.name: todo_app_todo_histories
models.description: Edit history entries for todos, recording timestamp and changed field values. Each entry is created when a todo is edited, storing the new values of title, description, startDate, dueDate, and completed status that were modified. This table serves as an append-only audit trail that users can view to track the complete modification history of their todos, sorted from most recent to oldest. History entries are automatically deleted when the parent todo is permanently removed from the trash.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the edit was made and history entry was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the history entry was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the history entry was soft-deleted.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Title value at the time of edit. Null if title was not changed in this edit.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Description value at the time of edit. Null if description was not changed in this edit.

plainFields.name: start_date
plainFields.description: Start date value at the time of edit. Null if start date was not changed or not set in this edit.

plainFields.name: due_date
plainFields.description: Due date value at the time of edit. Null if due date was not changed or not set in this edit.

plainFields.name: completed
plainFields.description: Completion status at the time of edit. Null if completion status was not changed in this edit.

models.name: todo_app_todos
models.description:
Core todo items with title, description, dates, completion status, and soft delete. Owned by members via todo_app_member_id foreign key for data isolation and privacy enforcement.

Each todo represents a task that can be created, edited, completed, and deleted by its owner. Soft deletion enables trash management where deleted todos can be restored or permanently removed.

Relationships:
- Belongs to {@link todo_app_members} for ownership
- Has many {@link todo_app_todo_histories} for edit audit trail (managed separately)

foreignFields.name: todo_app_member_id
foreignFields.description: Owner member's {@link todo_app_members.id}. Enforces data isolation and privacy - members can only access their own todos.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Todo title (required, 1-500 characters). The main descriptive text for the task.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Todo description (optional, 0-2000 characters). Additional details about the task.

plainFields.name: start_date
plainFields.description: Optional start date for the todo. Used for sorting and filtering tasks by when they begin.

plainFields.name: due_date
plainFields.description: Optional due date for the todo. Used for sorting and filtering tasks by deadline.

plainFields.name: completed
plainFields.description: Completion status. True when the todo is marked as complete, false otherwise. Defaults to false when created.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the todo was created. Immutable after creation.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the todo was last updated. Automatically updated on any modification.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the todo was soft deleted. Null for active todos, set to current time when deleted. Enables trash management and restoration.
